classificationNote: Europe research (24 companies) was present at process start; 67 other companies are unknown. Classification must not be compared directly to the final 50/250 or 40/200 game categories.
incomeMeasurementNote: Initial sectorIncome metric includes positive Performance au Départ payments. Treat this as gross sector + positive capital-performance receipts, not pure sector income. Later scenarios exclude payments without a companyId and measure performance injections/withdrawals separately.
